name: owned-api-declarations
goal: Package declarations for owner-local cross-workspace SDK functions without changing public import paths

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Owner-local placement puts three Web-compatible public SDK modules under Reports. The build still fixes TypeScript rootDir to src, so API declaration generation fails TS6059. Preserve placement and public SDK addresses while emitting the complete transitive declaration tree.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: General typecheck admits workspace sources; the declaration boundary was only checked late in a full build. Extend packaged API coverage with a focused declaration-only build that asserts configured public type entry paths exist, plus typed console imports in the empty consumer.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 30c0e35a fails the actual public declaration build in an isolated source fixture. Immutable red ef3d9e4c15822784fa815fbc053d05f5708ff1cb21dbad0fa0782a20952d9095 records TS6059 and the public API build assertion; live source and regression snapshot inputs remain unchanged.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Emit declarations using the repository as the source root, retaining transitive owner-local files under dist/types. Generate forwarding declaration entries at the existing public dist/types/lib paths. Add a declaration-only mode to the existing builder so the packaged API guard can run early and independently.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: The existing API builder emits the complete transitive declaration tree under dist/types and writes stable public type forwarders. Its types-only mode uses the same builder without application or kernel work. The standard packaged API test checks public entry files and a strict typed console consumer.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged isolated packaged API type coverage passes at c8e23662. Green affe51bae03f7265207e6eca3fd5863348f2d52642305b52aa2322beeb6c1fa5 pairs with test-only red ef3d9e4c15822784fa815fbc053d05f5708ff1cb21dbad0fa0782a20952d9095 using the same test corpus, command and environment.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: An isolated archive of c8e23662 ran the unchanged declaration guard. Reintroducing the old builder failed the public API type-build assertion; restoring the fixed builder passed. Logs: /tmp/harness-owned-api-guard-{red,green}.log. The test itself isolates all declaration writes outside live and frozen source.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
